dashboard.title: Promoter dashboard
dashboard.description: Publish and manage your events from this dashboard.

team.description: Assign reusable access across every event owned by this organization. Event-specific staff assignments remain available for temporary crews.
team.existingAccountHelp: The person must already have a Strikers Match account. Adding the same email again changes their role.
team.invitationHelp: Existing accounts receive access immediately. New users receive a secure registration invitation by email.
team.empty: No team members have been added yet.

invitation.title: Join an organization team
invitation.signedInReady: You are signed in as {{email}}. Accept to activate your organization access.
invitation.wrongAccount: This invitation belongs to {{email}}, but you are signed in as {{currentEmail}}. Sign out and use the invited account.
invitation.existingAccount: A Strikers Match account already exists for {{email}}. Sign in to accept this invitation.
invitation.emailLocked: The invitation is tied to this email address and cannot be changed.
invitation.confirmEmailDescription: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. After confirming, return here and sign in to activate your team access.

errors.invalid: This invitation is invalid or has already been used.
errors.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the organization owner to send a new one.
errors.emailMismatch: Sign in with the email address that received this invitation.

owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Full control, including Stripe ownership and organization security.

organization_admin.label: Organization administrator
organization_admin.description: Manages the team and all event areas, but cannot connect or own the Stripe account.

event_manager.label: Event manager
event_manager.description: Creates and edits events and manages participants, matchmaking, bouts and printouts.

matchmaker.label: Matchmaker
matchmaker.description: Manages participants, matchmaking, official bouts and bout printouts.

operations.label: Operations
operations.description: Runs event-day bout status, results, timing and operational printouts.

media_producer.label: Media / producer
media_producer.description: Accesses graphics, display mode and streaming production tools.

finance.label: Finance
finance.description: Manages registration fees, payment confirmation, payment activity and refunds.

read_only.label: Read only
read_only.description: Can review organization events and private event information without making changes.

errors.requestFailed: The team request could not be completed.
errors.accountNotFound: No active Strikers Match account was found for that email.
errors.ownerImplicit: The organization owner already has full access.
errors.notAuthorized: You do not have permission to manage this team.
errors.memberNotFound: The team member could not be found.
errors.ownerNotAllowed: This account cannot own an event organization.
errors.accountUnavailable: That account cannot be added to the organization.
errors.emailUnavailable: Team invitation email is not configured.
errors.emailFailed: The invitation was created, but the email could not be delivered. Try sending it again.
